verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is an online legal and business-services platform that could plausibly offer an API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any API, API keys, or scoped or least-privilege credentials for agents. The llms.txt probe only gives guidance to AI crawlers and is not a credential-issuance capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
